# Detailed variant routes

The short playbooks remain the normal entry. Load a detailed family below only
when the current gap needs a distinction the short playbook does not explain.
These are original method distillations, not commands to invoke upstream skills.

| Gap or distinction | Detailed reference |
| --- | --- |
| Decision frontier, elicitation depth, premise framing, async questionnaires, explanation, supporting principles or source invocation restrictions | [Core method variants](coverage-methods.md) |
| Actor/use-case/graph semantics, brownfield provenance, document conflicts, GSD modes, Spec Kit project policy or ProductShape host differences | [Model and specification variants](coverage-models.md) |
| Spec Kit specify/clarify/checklist/analyze/converge distinctions, question budgets, reviewer ownership, hooks and project policies | [Spec Kit variants](coverage-speckit.md) |
| Specialist actor/state/evidence lenses, source-owner authority, synthetic scenarios, cached version differences or optional tool boundaries | [Specialist variants](coverage-specialists.md) |
| Example Mapping, quality priorities, runtime/change scenarios, event-heavy perspectives or limited BMAD stances | [Public methodology variants](coverage-methodologies.md) |
| Prohibited providers, existing GSD state, connected owner documents or official product sources | [Evidence-route boundaries](coverage-routing.md) |

The source repository's `docs/coverage/variant-ledger.json` is the
maintenance record. Every variant has a source, disposition and adopted reference
or exclusion. A recorded `blocked_unverified` item is unavailable evidence, not a
technique the shared skill claims to reproduce. Cached files and source hashes
establish provenance; they do not establish activation or tested behavior.
